The '''''Defiant''''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].

==History==
It participated in the [[Battle of Koros Major]] in the lead-up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

Before transit to the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] [[Fleet Captain/Legends|Fleet Captain]] [[Vanicus]] ordered the ''Defiant'' to lock down its forward [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] before the jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
